gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed, histologically-confirmed supratentorial WHO grade IV gliomas including glioblastoma (all variants) and gliosarcoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will investigate whether or not intensified radiation therapy adapted during the radiation treatment course to high-risk, treatment-resistant tumor regions will improve overall survival
Temozolomide chemotherapy (75 mg/m2 daily for 6 weeks)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Multiparametric MR-Guided High Dose Adaptive Radiotherapy With Concurrent Temozolomide in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide chemotherapy (75 mg/m2 daily for 6 weeks)

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, concurrent with radiotherapy (standard of care)

role_evidence.quote: Adjuvant temozolomide will be delivered at 150-200 mg/m2 days 1-5 every 28 days for 6 cycles

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, adjuvant phase (standard of care)

coder_notes: The investigational question is dose-intensified adaptive radiotherapy; temozolomide is given at standard Stupp doses as background, so soc_backbone (not established_therapy_experiment). No pharmacological candidate; exclusion reason coded established_therapy_only (only drug is an established GBM therapy), though no_pharmacological_candidate is a defensible alternative. 'WHO grade IV gliomas including glioblastoma' with no IDH requirement, and secondary progression from low-grade glioma allowed, so cns5_terminology historical. Advanced MRI GTV is an imaging marker, not a molecular biomarker.
